summary:
A solar system map with clickable animated markers. The markers on clicking  pops up a fun snippet. 
Kids can relate to clicking planet and a spacecraft nearby and learn about its mission and discoveries.
Anyone interested in space today must know about past mission.
details:
A solar system map with animated clickable markers, on being clicked gives a brief detail about the mission. This is to help kids relate which planet and mission is related because of visual relationship.

The second page has more navigation tabs according to categories from Sun to interstellar space, by timeline, by missions completed but still functioning, dramatic and daring stories about some missions which discovered secrets, which could not have been found.

We used basic html and css for the project and we used CGPT for the same.

Since space history is going on for many years, the data is abundant for children, so simplifying it and arousing curiosity in easy way will help them remember better.

There are too many projects and activities present already for children and some interesting way where children will rely on for further reference is the idea we have presented.
